scenarios.name: Toxic 2 gives two poison counters and Necrogen Rotpriest's own trigger adds a third
scenarios.ruling: Toxic does not change the damage dealt: the defending player loses 1 life, gets two poison counters from toxic 2 and one more from the Rotpriest's triggered ability.

scenarios.name: The Rotpriest's trigger adds a poison counter when another toxic creature you control connects
scenarios.ruling: The trigger watches every creature you control with toxic, so Skrelv's toxic 1 becomes two poison counters while the Rotpriest stays home.

scenarios.name: The Rotpriest's activated ability gives a toxic creature deathtouch and kills its blocker
scenarios.ruling: Any nonzero amount of damage from a source with deathtouch is lethal, so the 1/5 Rotpriest destroys a 2/2 blocker and survives the 2 damage back.
